description.zh-CN:
OpenCompass 学术开源评测集目前聚焦大语言模型综合推理能力。
- 目前选取的数据集包括 综合知识推理 (MMLU-Pro /GPQA-Diamond(repeat-4) /HLE) ,数学推理 (AIME2025(repeat-32)) ,代码生成 (LiveCodeBench(repeat-6)) ,指令跟随 (IFEval)。
- 评测集会以月度为单位进行持续更新，纳入社区最新的研究进展。
- 当前模型评测以对话模型为主，不定期更新社区最新模型，相关提示词和复现脚本参考OpenCompass代码仓库。
- 模型评测结果会随着工具链的迭代同步更新。
- OpenCompass项目中提供了复现学术榜单的配置文件，具体请查阅官方文档。
description.en-US:
The CompassAcademic currently focuses on the comprehensive reasoning abilities of LLMs.
- The datasets selected so far include General Knowledge Reasoning (MMLU-Pro /GPQA-Diamond(repeat-4) /HLE), Mathematical Reasoning (AIME2025(repeat-32)), Code Completion (LiveCodeBench(repeat-6)), and Instruction Following (IFEval).
- The benchmark is updated monthly to incorporate the latest research advancements from the community.
- Currently, the evaluation primarily targets chat models, with updates featuring the latest community models at irregular intervals. Prompts and reproduction scripts can be found in the OpenCompass toolkit.
- The model evaluation results will be updated synchronously with the iteration of the toolchain. 
- OpenCompass provides configurations for reproducing this leaderboard. Please refer to the documentation for details.

desc.zh-CN: MiniCPM SALA是第一个有效整合稀疏和线性注意力的大规模混合模型，用于百万Token上下文建模。
desc.en-US: MiniCPM-SALA is the first large-scale hybrid model effectively integrating sparse and linear attention for million-token context modeling.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen3.5 是阿里近期推出的重要基础模型，在多模态融合、混合高效架构、规模化强化学习、多语言覆盖及训练基建上实现全面升级，性能与实用性大幅提升。
desc.en-US: Qwen3.5 is a significant foundation model recently launched by Alibaba, featuring comprehensive upgrades in multimodal fusion, efficient hybrid architecture, scalable reinforcement learning, multilingual coverage and training infrastructure, with greatly improved performance and practicality.

desc.zh-CN: GLM-5 是面向复杂系统工程与长时序智能体任务推出的新一代模型，在保持长上下文能力的同时大幅降低部署成本，延续了通过模型缩放提升 AGI 智能效率的核心路径
desc.en-US: GLM-5 is a new model launched for complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks, which significantly reduces deployment costs while maintaining long-context capabilities, and continues the core approach of improving AGI intelligence efficiency through model scaling.

desc.zh-CN: MiniMax-M2.5是在数十万复杂真实环境中经大规模强化学习训练，在编程、智能体工具使用等多项高价值任务上达到 SOTA 水平，推理与任务分解效率高、执行速度显著提升，且成本极低、性价比突出，有望催生全新智能体应用的前沿模型。
desc.en-US: MiniMax-M2.5 is a cutting-edge model extensively trained via reinforcement learning in hundreds of thousands of complex real-world environments, achieving state-of-the-art performance in coding, agentic tool use, and many economically valuable tasks, with high reasoning efficiency, significantly improved execution speed, and extremely low cost, promising to enable innovative new agentic applications.

desc.zh-CN: 由月之暗面公司最新推出的模型，具备更强代码能力、更擅长通用Agent任务。所使用版本号为kimi-k2.5。

desc.zh-CN: Step-3.5-Flash adopts the MoE architecture, achieving a balance between inference ability and operational efficiency, significantly improving the response speed of the model in complex agent workflows.
